card: ROLE: Titled general and wealthy suitor; owner of the Tazzum mines; approached Oda with his military record and fortune as courtship credentials.
TRAIT: Flamboyantly dressed — elaborate green headdress, helmet, and staff-like object; presents himself as a figure of spectacle and display.
TRAIT: Extremely wealthy; identifies himself through his fortune and the Tazzum mines as much as through his military title.
TRAIT: Claims to have defeated an emperor of Androkla-5; frames the conquest as evidence of devotion.
TRAIT: Presented a rose fashioned from the intestines of a defeated emperor as a courtship offering — theatrical, extravagant, and grotesque.
RELATIONSHIP: oda__princess (Oda): rejected suitor; offered an intestine-rose fashioned from a conquered emperor; publicly and flatly refused; knocked away mid-presentation by a violent upward burst.
VOICE: In the courtship presentation, speaks as a magnate announcing a military triumph; declaration of feeling delivered as a conquest report.
BOUNDARY: No confirmed later role, recovery, or knowledge of Aghnar's lineage or Metabaronic affairs beyond the failed courtship presentation.
BOUNDARY: No established awareness of rivals for Oda or of the dynasty with prior claim on her.

manual_review_notes: Source-thin singleton minor character; the card is compact, source-grounded, and honest about its boundaries.
